name: Super Soft Dual-Sided Sherpa Fleece Comforter Blanket (90x90 in)
description: Wrap yourself in pure cloud-like comfort! This ultra-cozy, heavy-weight 90x90 inch Queen-size comforter features a smart dual-sided design perfect for chilly nights or lounging on the couch. The top layer is made of an incredibly plush, ribbed jacquard flannel fleece in a modern slate gray, while the reverse side is lined with a thick, bone-white faux sherpa wool fleece that locks in warmth flawlessly. Highly breathable, anti-static, and holds its fluff beautifully after washing. Please note: This comes from a pet-friendly home with a cat. The comforter has been fully laundered, deeply sanitized, and thoroughly lint-rolled before listing. Zero rips or tears—ready to upgrade your bed setup!
contact_note: Cat-friendly home. The comforter has been freshly washed and sanitized with premium allergen-free detergent right before listing. Please note that it does not come with the original storage bag, so please bring a bag or hamper for transport during pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned dual-sided slate gray and white sherpa fleece 90x90 comforter blanket in good condition. Freshly laundered, pet-friendly home.
name_zh: 双面加厚羊羔绒法兰绒保暖被/冬被大毯子 (90*90英寸 Queen)
description_zh: 冬天续命、宅家沙发煲剧必备的云朵级保暖神毯！这款大号 90x90 英寸（正方形 Queen 尺寸）的双面加厚复合被，采用拼色双面设计：正面是高级感十足的条纹肌理暗灰色法兰绒（Flannel），触感极为细腻丝滑；反面则是仿生加厚纯白羊羔绒（Sherpa），蓄热保暖性能无敌。面料防静电、不易起球，支持机洗。特别说明：家里养猫。发布前已经过全面深度洗涤、高温消毒与彻底除毛，无任何破损、无拉丝。注：本品不含原厂收纳袋，自提时请自带袋子或篮子装运，高性价比速出。
